notes.text:
- Further improved generation success rate.
- Renamed item groups to prevent group names being shared with individual items.
- Fixed a problem with Vasebreaker randomisation that could cause crashes when playing with the GOTY client.

This update only affects the .apworld file. The client mod is unchanged from v1.10.1.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/replanted_archipelago/blob/main/apworld/docs/setup.md)
